methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops targeting technology gap closure in Hampton Roads signals grassroots capability-building that could distribute deep fluency through community networks rather than platform dependency.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: WorkAI Lab at Roanoke College creates institutional AI capability in a non-metro region, but as a single academic hub it risks becoming an isolated pocket rather than distributing knowledge to surrounding Appalachian communities.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership explicitly targets community impact and education breadth, signaling intentional distribution strategy that could spread deep AI literacy beyond the university hub into Richmond's wider ecosystem.

signals.title: Inside the AI-powered system sorting Hampton Roads' trash - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: AI-powered trash sorting represents platform-delivered automation applied to municipal operations—shallow implementation that provides efficiency without building local AI development capacity or transferable technical skills.

signals.title: Second Major Virginia Data Center Project Dies, Raising AI Site Selection Stakes - Data Center Knowledge
signals.signal_reading: Major data center projects dying in NoVA despite infrastructure advantages signals that even concentrated regions face deployment barriers, potentially stalling both metro capability growth and any spillover to rural areas.
